subject: general
question: At the 2025 Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit, China made several significant announcements. Which of the following was NOT one of the major initiatives pledged by China?

options.text: $$2 billion grant to SCO member countries
Launching a $10 billion grant for AI development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Launching a $10 billion grant for AI development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **At the 2025 SCO Summit, China committed to several initiatives including a $2 billion grant, expanded scholarships, and livelihood projects.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **China pledged RMB 2 billion (approx. $274 million) in grants to SCO member countries by 2025.**
 
• China committed to launching 100 "Small and Beautiful" projects focused on health, education, and community welfare.
 
• China also pledged to double SCO-specific scholarships and start a PhD program to promote academic collaboration in science and technology.
 
• However, there was no mention of launching a $10 billion grant specifically for AI development, making this the incorrect option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tianjin Declaration__

 __
 
• Adopted at the 2025 SCO Summit, emphasizing responsible AI development and inclusive cooperation among SCO members.
 
 
 
• Luban Workshops__
 __
 
• China plans to establish 10 Luban Workshops across SCO countries to enhance vocational training in advanced manufacturing and technology.
 
 
 
• AI Development Cooperation Roadmap__
 __
 
• Part of the SCO's initiative to foster collaborative and secure AI research, with a focus on fairness and transparency.
 
 
 
• India’s Role__
 
 
• India emphasized ethical, people-centered AI development and equitable access to emerging technologies during the summit.
